name_reason: The '_13' suffix is a legitimate domain ID (spell id 0x13 = 風行術, a support/buff spell), not a Ghidra address residue (function lives at 0x22960). But the 'stage_c' descriptor is misleading: per the documented family analysis (and the refined sibling 0x12 plate), spell 0x11/0x12/0x13 are three DISTINCT buff spells (AP / DP / speed), NOT three stages of one spell. Renaming to fd2_cast_spell_13_speed_boost mirrors the worker name fd2_cast_speed_boost_spell and accurately reflects the effect. Rename recorded only; applied in Stage 2.
purpose: Battle spell-dispatch wrapper for spell id 0x13 (風行術 / speed boost): resets the AoE target counter, deducts caster MP, then delegates to the speed-boost worker.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x10) stack probe; sets global data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx = 0; calls fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster, 0x13) to charge MP using cost-table index 0x13; calls fd2_cast_speed_boost_spell(caster, n_targets, target_id_array) which applies the speed buff and its animation; returns void. Single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1. Reached only via the spell dispatch table entry at 0x51D4D (table base 0x51D01 + 0x4C, index 0x13); no direct callers.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_13_stage_c(uint32 caster, uint32 n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; passed through to fd2_deduct_caster_mp (whose MP is charged) and to the speed-boost worker as the buff source/caster.
params.reason: Clean, meaningful name (Ghidra decompile names it caster_unit_id); no address residue. Accurately reflects the caller-supplied unit id.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: Number of targets; forwarded unchanged to fd2_cast_speed_boost_spell as the target count.
params.reason: Clear abbreviation for 'number of targets' (Ghidra: num_targets); consistent with sibling wrappers in the same file; no address residue.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: Pointer to the target-id byte array; cast to uint32 and forwarded to the speed-boost worker which iterates the target ids.
params.reason: Clear name for 'target array' (Ghidra: target_id_array); consistent with the rest of spell.c; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effects are MP deduction, AoE-counter reset, and the speed-buff application/animation performed by the delegate.

comment_original_issue: The src function had NO comment block (its 0x11 and 0x12 siblings both do). Missing the spell identity (風行術 / speed boost), the AoE-counter reset, the MP cost-index detail, and the family clarification that 0x11/0x12/0x13 are distinct buff spells (not stages).
notes: Dispatch table entry 0x51D4D reads bytes 60 29 02 00 = 0x00022960, confirming this is the index-0x13 handler. Disassembly matches decompilation exactly (MOV [0x53ec4],0; PUSH 0x13 + CALL fd2_deduct_caster_mp; CALL fd2_cast_speed_boost_spell; RET). KB (fd2-knowledge) confirms spell 0x13 = 風行術, 輔助法術 (support), MP 8, range 4, AoE 2. Note divergence from siblings: 0x11 and 0x12 both charge MP via cost index 0x12, but this wrapper charges via its own spell id 0x13 -- documented in both src comment and plate. Rename recorded only (Stage 2 will apply, touching protos.h + dispatch-table-referencing src); name/param symbols not changed this stage.
